agreements: The current v1e bytes cannot proceed to ratification, implementation, model dispatch, heldout exposure, GPU use, fitting, or scientific promotion. A newly identified and newly hash-bound successor must undergo fresh interpretation, critique, consensus, and exact human ratification.

The successor should preserve the frozen v03r source closure, one aligned seed-5 twin pair, environment-generated actions, immutable witnessed and fallibly model-supported rows, deterministic recurrence, fixed OWN/DIST return branches, prospective text interventions, conditional exactly-two-adapter transport, no retry, and the existing stage order unless a listed repair directly requires otherwise.

The registered arithmetic remains coherent and must not change: 216 DEV controller opportunities; 632 HELDOUT_TEXT opportunities comprising 232 DREAM, 232 prospectively paired SELF_CHECK, 24 THINK0, and 144 THINK1_TEXT; 48 conditional THINK1_LORA opportunities; 896 maximum 32B controller opportunities overall; exactly two 7B fits; 96 fidelity cases; and at most 48 online 7B reads.

DREAM and same-model SELF_CHECK are fallible model organs rather than truth verifiers. Structurally valid false self-approved rows remain eligible, and no repair may introduce private truth, answer verification, outcome-selected repair, semantic-oracle admission, or retry.

P1CB06 identifies only the sixteen-slot goal-routed return treatment after the shared 84-slot recurrent prefix. It cannot establish necessity of recurrence, repeated dreaming, graph growth, generic construction, action improvement, or online learning as a whole.

A green text stage could support only instance-local causal use by this exact endpoint-cued, ontology- and proof-sequence-scaffolded system on one deterministic pair, subject to the complete registered M0, DIST, TWIN, PATH, SHAM, offline-correctness, structural-use, accounting, and review conjunction.

A green LoRA stage could support only immediate selected-cue candidate-constrained training-set-resubstitution recognition for each of two isolated per-life adapters plus their registered own/donor paths. It cannot support preservation, unseen or open recall, whole-corpus storage, durability, capacity, scale, generalization, text equivalence, baseline superiority, or the Paper-1 headline.

SELF_DECLARED_UNVERIFIED role and freshness records may be retained only as transparent unauthenticated audit metadata under externally witnessed project procedure. They are not proof of identity, freshness, independence, or non-fabrication and cannot alone authorize a stage or support an anti-self-certification claim.

Negative results remain local to the registered stage and reason. The canary has engineering integration value only; it provides no population, comparative, action-improvement, reliability, or Paper-1-scale inference.

disagreements.issue: Whether aggregate wildcard-like consumes lists can satisfy the literal reciprocal dependency rule, or the successor needs one canonical exact file-edge registry.

positions.position: The row-per-file matrix and phrases such as all operation and state schemas, all normative contracts and schemas, all schema files, and all other normative files are intended to encode exhaustive reciprocal closure.

Literal comparison leaves 25 producer edges without filename-identical consumer declarations, so wildcard interpretation would require implementer-selected expansion and violates the single-executable-reading rule.

resolution.rationale: The literal rule controls, and current bytes fail it. Manually duplicated wildcard lists would preserve ambiguity and create two editable sources of truth.
resolution.selected_position: Use one canonical ASCII-sorted registry of exact direct file-edge tuples as the sole normative dependency source; allow only mechanically derived per-file producer and consumer views, with no wildcard, aggregate prose endpoint, or independently maintained duplicate edge list.
resolution.required_change: In a newly hash-bound successor, replace the ambiguous edge encoding with exact filename tuples covering every normative file and all 25 identified missing reciprocals. Specify the deterministic projection from the canonical registry to per-file provides and consumes views and require exact set equality among registry, derived views, context inventory, object/order/validity/ledger bindings, and exactly P1CB01 through P1CB10. Fold the critique's missing literal-edge test into P1CB01, with missing, extra, duplicate, asymmetric, nonfilename, wildcard, category-mismatch, and stale-derived-view negatives. Preserve the opportunity ledger as the sole condition/state/reason authority.

disagreements.issue: How terminal-review rejection, invalidity, missing or malformed dispositions, role overlap, or terminal-packet construction failure reaches HUMAN_TERMINAL without circular approval.

positions.position: Every failure builds a reviewed terminal packet and the authority token binds two completed dispositions before HUMAN_TERMINAL.
A failed terminal review cannot satisfy the two-APPROVE rule, while reviewing another terminal packet recursively has no base case.

resolution.rationale: Fail-closed termination must be total and cannot depend on approval of the failed review mechanism.
resolution.selected_position: Define a direct, nonrecursive HUMAN_TERMINAL fail-stop receipt distinct from a successor authority token.
resolution.required_change: Add one closed fail-stop receipt schema and transition for terminal reviewer or advocate REJECT/INVALID, malformed or missing terminal disposition, prohibited role overlap, changed reviewed bytes, and terminal packet or claim-artifact construction failure. The receipt must bind the predecessor authority or ratification, exact packet or failed-construction manifest when available, all available assignment/disposition hashes, a closed failure reason, reconciled partial accounting, and no-retry/no-further-dispatch proof. It grants no execution or claim authority, requires no approving disposition, cannot trigger another review, and enters HUMAN_TERMINAL exactly once. Fold all listed positive and negative base-case vectors into P1CB01, P1CB09, and P1CB10.

disagreements.issue: Whether one P1CB10 artifact can be both inside the immutable pre-review packet and evidence of dispositions and transition that exist only after review.

positions.position: Every packet contains artifacts.p1cb10 while P1CB10 also validates the later assignments, dispositions, authority transition, and HUMAN_TERMINAL outcome.
Static mechanism evidence can precede review, but realized disposition and transition evidence cannot be an immutable member of the packet it reports on.

resolution.rationale: The current single-artifact placement is temporally circular even though the packet's prose noncircularity rule is correct.
resolution.selected_position: Retain P1CB10 as one registered test ID but split its evidence into an immutable pre-review mechanism phase and a post-review realized-transition phase.
resolution.required_change: The packet may bind only a pre-review P1CB10 mechanism/fixture receipt proving schema, inventory, claim-linter, separation-request plan, and negative vectors without any future assignment, response, disposition, authority, or terminal digest. After review, create a separate P1CB10 transition receipt binding the unchanged packet, assignments, completed dispositions, reviewer supremacy result, and exactly one successor token or direct HUMAN_TERMINAL fail-stop. A final P1CB10 evidence manifest may join both phase hashes only after review and must never be retroactively inserted into the reviewed packet. Add ordering and future-digest rejection vectors under the existing P1CB10 ID.

disagreements.issue: When the 48 conditional THINK1_LORA opportunities become registered relative to fitting and fidelity, and how fidelity failure can account for them.

positions.position: The 48 opportunities are conditionally registered and authorized only after reviewed text and fidelity gates.
Fidelity failure must emit one zero-attempt row for each of 48 already registered opportunities, which is impossible if registration occurs only after fidelity passes.

resolution.rationale: Prospective denominator registration and dispatch authority are distinct lifecycle events and must not be conflated.
resolution.selected_position: After valid reviewed Stage-T authority and before either fit or fidelity request, prospectively register and seal all 48 THINK1_LORA opportunities; withhold their dispatch authority until both separate 44/48 fidelity gates pass.
resolution.required_change: Define exact lifecycle states for registered-not-dispatchable and dispatch-authorized. Seal the 48 IDs, lives, arms, slots, seeds, and denominator before fitting. On either fidelity gate failure, emit exactly one zero-attempt NON_DISPATCH_STAGE_FIDELITY_FAILURE/NON_DISPATCH_STAGE_FAILURE/FIDELITY_GATE_FAILED row for every registered L opportunity; on joint pass, authorize ordinary dispatch. Missing, late, dynamic, result-selected, deleted, rekeyed, or partly authorized registrations fail closed. Preserve the 48 and 896 arithmetic and fold the missing lifecycle vectors into P1CB01, P1CB08, and P1CB09.

disagreements.issue: Whether THINK0 is accurately described as target-absent when it receives the exact final source and target endpoints and an explicit missing-join agenda.

positions.position: Target-absent emphasizes that the final animal, rendered final question, answer, private truth, and donor are not shown to THINK0.
The exact source and target equal the later goal endpoints, so target-absent materially overstates autonomous relevance discovery even though no answer is leaked.

resolution.rationale: Both factual components matter: this is not direct answer leakage, but it is endpoint and agenda cueing.
resolution.selected_position: Use the exact label final-question/animal/answer withheld, endpoint-cued, and disclose that THINK0's source and target equal the later final-goal endpoints and explicitly request their causal join.
resolution.required_change: Replace target-absent in every thesis, question, graph, loop, claim, prompt description, review fixture, and terminal interpretation where it describes THINK0. Add a construct-disclosure vector asserting endpoint equality while independently proving absence of final animal, rendered question, answer, intervention truth, private factorization, donor identity, and evaluator result. State that P1CB02 demonstrates registered taint behavior, not absence of the disclosed goal agenda, and forbid autonomous relevance-discovery claims.

disagreements.issue: Whether FINAL_GOAL_OR_DONOR_BACKEND may remain one visibility item despite different THINK1 permissions.

positions.position: A visible THINK1 cell is qualified by prose saying the public question is visible while donor/backend identity stays hidden.
A machine consuming the cell value can interpret visible as permission for both components, so the exhaustive matrix is unsafe and non-atomic.

resolution.rationale: Visibility permissions must be atomic and machine-readable; prose cannot negate a visible permission on half of a compound item.
resolution.selected_position: Split FINAL_GOAL_PUBLIC_QUESTION and DONOR_BACKEND_IDENTITY into separate information items and regenerate the complete stage Cartesian product.
resolution.required_change: Assign the public final question visible only after its authorized reveal and at THINK1/OFFLINE_EVAL as specified; keep donor/backend identity forbidden from DREAM, SELF_CHECK, THINK0, RETURN_DREAM, COMPILE_OR_TRAIN, and THINK1, with visibility only to offline audit where necessary. Preserve separate host-only final-goal coordinates before reveal. Add exact completeness, no-compound-item, and donor-taint negatives to P1CB01, P1CB02, and P1CB04.

disagreements.issue: What authority and scientific meaning SELF_DECLARED_UNVERIFIED reviewer/advocate records may carry.

positions.position: Distinct role labels, declared freshness, and two approving dispositions prevent self-certification and fabricated review evidence.

Without a trusted issuer, identity lookup, signature, or freshness proof, one producer can fabricate structurally valid distinct-role records; the records can document a requested procedure but cannot prove it occurred.

resolution.rationale: The proposal candidly lacks an authentication mechanism, so the narrower governance interpretation is the only supportable one.
resolution.selected_position: Retain SELF_DECLARED_UNVERIFIED records solely as unauthenticated, non-scientific audit annotations; require an external human/operator witness as the sole authority for actual role and fresh-context separation, and remove every technical anti-self-certification or anti-fabrication claim.
resolution.required_change: State in the stage contract, authority rules, packets, assignments, dispositions, P1CB10 fixtures, terminal claims, and human scope that schema validity proves only internal formatting and hash binding. A stage must not advance on self-declared records alone: the external supervisor must explicitly witness and release the exact immutable packet after separate invocations, while no artifact claims authenticated identity, freshness, independence, or non-fabrication. If no witness release exists, direct fail-stop to HUMAN_TERMINAL. Preserve reviewer supremacy and changed-byte rereview as normative procedure, not scientific evidence.

disagreements.issue: Whether preserve immediate registered access is a permissible description of the LoRA fidelity gate.

positions.position: The LoRA stage asks whether isolated adapters preserve immediate candidate-constrained access.

positions.actor: benchmark interpretation, detailed contracts, and critique
positions.position: The same repeatedly trained selected row/view semantics are tested with host pre-resolution and answer-bearing rosters, so the evidence is training-set resubstitution recognition and cannot establish preservation.

resolution.rationale: The detailed protocol determines the evidentiary boundary; preservation entails unsupported temporal or storage content.
resolution.selected_position: Use immediate selected-cue candidate-constrained training-set-resubstitution recognition everywhere and prohibit preserve or preservation as a positive description of this stage.
resolution.required_change: Replace preservation wording in the system thesis, experiment question, graph and loop rationales, acceptance fixtures, falsification statements, review linter, human-facing scope, and terminal templates. Preserve disclosure of twelve selected M1_OWN training rows per life crossed with four repeatedly trained view families, host pre-resolution, one answer-bearing roster per cue, and separate 44/48 gates. Continue to reject unseen, heldout, open recall, storage, durability, capacity, generalization, text equivalence, and superiority claims.

disagreements.issue: Whether the compute envelope is justified as scientific evidence or only as an engineering integration canary.

positions.position: The staged one-pair run may expose integration failures before a later expensive replicated experiment and therefore can have practical value.

Up to 896 32B controller opportunities, 2304 candidate forward sequences, two rank-64 7B fits, 96 fidelity cases, and 48 online 7B reads yield no baseline comparison, replication, uncertainty, population inference, action endpoint, or Paper-1 claim.

resolution.rationale: The run may be useful for engineering de-risking but its evidentiary return is too narrow to count as a Paper-1 result. Adding strong baselines or replication would expand rather than minimally repair this canary.
resolution.selected_position: Preserve the experiment and arithmetic, but require a complete worst-case compute disclosure and explicit human acceptance of the spend solely as engineering integration de-risking before any GPU authority.
resolution.required_change: Add a human-readable, machine-bound compute manifest enumerating 216, 632, 48, and 896 controller opportunities; the 144 atomic read cycles and 2304 candidate forward-sequence ceiling; exact optimizer-step and token ceilings derived from the frozen two-fit recipe; exactly two fits; 96 fidelity cases; and at most 48 online 7B reads. P1CB01/P1CB09 must verify these quantities and fail on omission or mismatch; P1CB10 must require the engineering-only value statement and reject Paper-1, comparative, population, reliability, action-improvement, preservation, generalization, scale, or superiority promotion. Human ratification must separately affirm that this disclosed envelope is worth spending for integration diagnosis only.

concern_dispositions.rationale: The enumerated 25 one-sided literal edges violate the package's own reciprocal-edge rule; undefined aggregate expansion is not an executable lock.
concern_dispositions.required_change: Replace wildcard-like and independently duplicated endpoint lists with one canonical exact filename-edge registry, deterministic derived views, and the complete P1CB01 literal closure negatives.

concern_dispositions.rationale: Requiring approval to terminate a failed terminal review is circular and leaves promised HUMAN_TERMINAL reachability undefined.
concern_dispositions.required_change: Add the distinct non-authorizing, nonrecursive direct HUMAN_TERMINAL fail-stop receipt and exhaustive failure vectors.

concern_dispositions.rationale: A reviewed packet cannot contain realized evidence about dispositions and a transition that do not yet exist.
concern_dispositions.required_change: Split the existing P1CB10 evidence under the same test ID into pre-review mechanism evidence and post-review realized-transition evidence, with a post-review joining manifest.

concern_dispositions.rationale: Fidelity-failure non-dispatch rows require the 48 L opportunities to exist before the fidelity result, while current text registers them only after that gate.
concern_dispositions.required_change: Prospectively seal all 48 opportunities after reviewed T authority and before fitting, with dispatch withheld until both fidelity gates pass and exact zero-attempt failure rows otherwise.

concern_dispositions.rationale: The endpoint and missing-join agenda cue is material and must be disclosed, but final animal, rendered question, answer, private truth, intervention truth, factorization, and donor identity remain withheld, so this is not direct answer leakage.
concern_dispositions.required_change: Use final-question/animal/answer withheld, endpoint-cued everywhere and add the exact equality/absence disclosure vector under existing tests.

concern_dispositions.rationale: A visible permission cannot safely cover one visible and one forbidden component in an exhaustive machine-readable matrix.
concern_dispositions.required_change: Split public final-goal question visibility from donor/backend identity and regenerate the complete atomic visibility matrix.

concern_dispositions.rationale: Self-declared identifiers and freshness fields are structurally checkable but cannot authenticate the actor or prove fresh independent review.
concern_dispositions.required_change: Demote the records to unauthenticated audit metadata, require an explicit external witness release for advancement, and delete technical prevention, detection, attestation, independence, and non-fabrication claims.

concern_dispositions.rationale: Selected repeatedly trained cues with host-pre-resolved answer-bearing rosters measure immediate training-set resubstitution recognition, not preservation.
concern_dispositions.required_change: Replace preservation language everywhere with immediate selected-cue candidate-constrained training-set-resubstitution recognition and retain all narrow disclosures and prohibited claims.

concern_dispositions.rationale: The critique is correct that the design provides no Paper-1, comparative, replicated, population, or action evidence; it may nevertheless be worth running as a fail-fast integration diagnostic after complete compute disclosure and explicit human value judgment.
concern_dispositions.required_change: Preserve the one-pair experiment, add exact worst-case calls, candidate sequences, optimizer steps/tokens, fits, cases, and reads, and require human approval of engineering-only value before GPU authority.

upstream_disagreement_dispositions.rationale: Literal endpoint comparison confirms the matrix is not machine-exhaustive.
No finite nonrecursive artifact-bearing route exists for failure of terminal review itself.
SELF_DECLARED_UNVERIFIED evidence cannot support prevention or detection claims.
Final-question and donor/backend permissions differ and require separate matrix items.
Aggregate prose endpoints and nonreciprocal direct edges require a preferred normalization that the protocol forbids.
The exact endpoints and agenda make endpoint-cued the correct construct label, while withheld answer-bearing fields prevent classifying it as direct answer leakage.
Unverified records can document requested procedure but cannot establish anti-self-certification or review independence.
The locked evaluation is immediate selected-cue training-set resubstitution recognition and cannot support preservation language.

acceptance_test_dispositions.rationale: Preserve the ID and its post-ratification CPU position. Extend it to the canonical exact file-edge registry and derived-view closure, direct HUMAN_TERMINAL fail-stop, two-phase review ordering, prospective L registration, atomic visibility, external witness boundary, and complete compute manifest.

Preserve all existing taint and roster vectors, add exact THINK0-to-final endpoint equality plus independent absence checks, and split public-question from donor/backend visibility. Passing proves registered noninterference, not absence of endpoint agenda cueing.

Its current legal reducer, kind discrimination, immutable row, lineage, depth, conflict, cycle, hash, fallibility, and no-semantic-verifier boundary are not challenged and must be preserved byte-consistently in the successor.
Retain kind-disjoint queries, concrete cue-bound rosters, backend-neutral projection, and atomic mounts; add the split visibility cells and explicit donor/backend taint negatives.
Its six-life deterministic DEV headroom and shortcut gate remains valid, but it is not a learned-memory baseline comparison or evidence of paper-level value.

Its schedule and zero/OWN/DIST mechanics remain valid and its stated inference is already limited to the post-prefix return treatment. Successor prose must call THINK0 endpoint-cued without altering this test's experiment or arithmetic.

Its prospective six-arm conjunction, sham-infeasibility route, structural-use requirement, and stage-local meaning remain sound; interpretation must explicitly include endpoint cueing and one-pair limits.

Preserve two fixed fits, separate 44/48 gates, cue-bound answer rosters, atomic own/donor paths, and resubstitution-only meaning. Add prospective registration of all 48 L opportunities before fitting/fidelity and exact fidelity-failure non-dispatch accounting.

Preserve one-effect accounting, fixed denominators, validity mapping, ceilings, and no retry. Add canonical edge consistency, pre-fit 48-opportunity L registration, fidelity failure rows, terminal-review fail-stop accounting, and exact worst-case compute-manifest reconciliation.

Preserve immutable same-packet review, reviewer supremacy, changed-byte rereview, claim-state fixtures, and human stop. Split evidence into pre-review and post-review phases, add the direct terminal base case, demote self-declarations to audit metadata requiring external witness release, use endpoint-cued and resubstitution wording, and enforce engineering-only compute value.
